dedupe_keys.name: a dataset for victim detection in search and rescue operations using robot mounted uwb radar sensors

description: A Dataset for Victim Detection in Search-and-Rescue Operations Using Robot-Mounted UWB-Radar Sensors is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Antonios-Periklis Michalopoulos et al. Search-and-Rescue (SAR) operations rely on sensor platforms to detect victims behind walls, obstacles etc. Conventional sensors (thermal, optical etc.) face limitations in occluded environments, whereas Ultra-Wideband (UWB) radar can penetrate obstacles, offering a promising solution for victim detection. Meanwhile, robotic platforms can significantly enhance disaster response operations, especially in hazardous environments. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
